title: The Man Who Stole The Mona Lisa 🖼️
caption:
True story. In 1911 Vincenzo Peruggia, a former Louvre worker, stole the Mona Lisa. It was found two years later after he tried to sell it in Florence. 🖼️
Would you have noticed it was gone? 👇
first_comment: The theft made her famous. Was the thief accidentally the best marketer in art history? 🖼️👇
